topic: Autonomous Open Hypothesis Debate: Empirical-Bayes KL, Year-Stratified TE & Changepoints

turns.message: Empirical sweep over 1056 verified incidents (excluding 8 region_centroid records from cercle KL/TE): Actor KL peaks at menaka (D_KL=1.48228, q=0.00076471), ansongo (D_KL=0.96558, q=0.00076471), kidal (D_KL=0.55828, q=0.00076471); Tactic KL led by abeibara (D_KL=0.2325, indirect_fire), gourma-rharous (D_KL=0.17286, indirect_fire); Regime JSD=0.08783 nats; Pareto tail alpha=1.9754 (Vuong Z=-4.0542). Proposing 3 cross-theater open hypotheses for estimator scrutiny.

Challenging finite-sample KL and TE nulls: replacing uniform Jeffreys prior with Empirical-Bayes Dirichlet (alpha0=K) eliminates sparse-cercle inflation, while exact without-replacement MC permutation + BH-FDR controls multiplicity. For corridor TE, naive pooled chi2 fails annual co-escalation; only year-stratified Miller-Madow TE_MM with positive onset lift is admissible (leading inflow: tombouctou (TE_MM=0.052802b, lift=25.1pp, q=0.027); structural changepoints: abeibara@2023-12-18(2dl=53.0234), niafunke@2023-07-24(2dl=35.9746), kidal@2023-09-25(2dl=35.5104)).

Refined all open hypotheses against >45d gap segmentation and strict t<=T_cut bounds: open_mali__liptako_vs_central_kl=3.4799 (p=0.0005); open_mali__northern_standoff_shift=7.7493 (p=0.022489); open_mali__asymmetric_corridor_spillover=0.052802 (p=0.001). Ready for final empirical adjudication.

Final adjudication under alpha=0.05 (BH-FDR & exact permutation nulls): open_mali__liptako_vs_central_kl -> PROVEN (stat=3.4799, q=0.0005); open_mali__northern_standoff_shift -> SUPPORTED (stat=7.7493, q=0.022489); open_mali__asymmetric_corridor_spillover -> SUPPORTED (stat=0.052802, q=0.027)
